fixedFailures.rootCause: Test expected heading 'The sharper marketplace for Malta' but actual H1 was 'Jobs with clearer signals.' after brand modernization.
fixedFailures.fix: Updated test assertion to /Jobs with clearer signals/ to match approved brand copy.

fixedFailures.testName: salary calculator page loads and works
fixedFailures.rootCause: Test clicked Calculate button before client-side hydration completed. onSubmit handler not yet bound. Also strict mode violations on ambiguous locators.
fixedFailures.fix: Added data-testid='salary-calculator' wrapper. Test now waits for wrapper visible + button enabled before interacting. Removed redundant locator assertions.

fixedFailures.testName: mobile navigation opens and is accessible
fixedFailures.rootCause: Test used CSS selector '.md:hidden nav' and 'Toggle menu' aria-label. Button aria-label now toggles between 'Open menu'/'Close menu'. Mobile nav is conditionally mounted, not CSS-hidden.
fixedFailures.fix: Added aria-controls='mobile-navigation' to button, id='mobile-navigation' + role='navigation' + aria-label='Mobile navigation' to nav. Test uses getByRole('button', { name: /Open menu/ }) and getByRole('navigation', { name: /mobile/i }). After click, re-queries for 'Close menu' button.

fixedFailures.testName: theme toggle switches between dark and light
fixedFailures.rootCause: Theme toggle button is hydration-gated (useHydrated). Server renders placeholder span. Test queried button before hydration completed. Also aria-labels were 'Switch to light/dark mode' which didn't match test regex.
fixedFailures.fix: Changed aria-label to stable 'Toggle theme' on both desktop and admin headers. Added data-testid='theme-toggle' on button, data-testid='theme-toggle-placeholder' on server placeholder. Test uses getByRole('button', { name: /toggle theme/i }).

fixedFailures.rootCause: SearchFilters uses useSearchParams() inside Suspense boundary. Filter button and panel not in initial HTML. Test used getByRole('button', { name: /Show filters/ }) which matched but panel wasn't rendered yet.
fixedFailures.fix: Added data-testid='jobs-filter-button' to button, data-testid='jobs-filter-panel' + id='jobs-filter-panel' to panel. Updated aria-controls to 'jobs-filter-panel'. Test uses getByTestId with { waitUntil: 'networkidle' }.

fixedFailures.testName: search filters can be shown and hidden on desktop
fixedFailures.rootCause: Same as above. Panel CSS 'hidden' class was present but Playwright considered element visible due to Suspense deferral timing.
fixedFailures.fix: Same as above. Test uses getByTestId('jobs-filter-button') and getByTestId('jobs-filter-panel'). Verifies aria-expanded attribute toggles correctly.

fixedFailures.testName: homepage loads and is accessible + browse jobs page loads
fixedFailures.rootCause: axe-core color-contrast violation on decorative company avatar initials. Parent div had role='img' + aria-label causing axe to check contrast of child spans. Brand colors (purple-500, orange-500, warning, secondary, accent) at /10 and /20 opacity failed 4.5:1 WCAG AA threshold.
fixedFailures.fix: Changed getAvatarColor to return only background classes (no text color). Added text-foreground to the initials span for guaranteed contrast. Removed role='img' + aria-label from parent when no logo URL (initials-only path).
